remarks: This 3-bedroom 2.5 bath colonial with covered front porch has a flexible floor plan, great room with vaulted ceiling and French doors to a private deck. Additional rooms include a home office, living / dining with fireplace & first floor laundry w/ half bath. All three bedrooms are on the second level, the primary suite features a vaulted ceiling, full bath with soaking tub & separate shower. At the basement level there is a separate entrance with mudroom, utility & storage areas, and an oversized garage. Centrally located just 4 short blocks (with sidewalks) from the Noroton Heights Shopping Center, Darien Commons and NH RR Station all of Darien's amenities are close at hand. HVAC Hydro Air system, gas fired boiler, tankless water heater, fire detection & security system included.
